@@ -1 +1,18 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are written with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) and live in `test_*.py`
+files alongside the modules they cover.
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+To run a single file or a single test:
+
+```sh
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
